title: `roots/list`
description: A server request for the client's filesystem roots, offered as informational guidance rather than as access control.
question: Can a server learn which directories the client is working in?
why: Roots tell a server where to look without it guessing paths. It is deprecated as of 2026-07-28 under SEP-2577, and its change notification was removed outright in the same revision, so support here is a legacy question rather than a forward-looking one.
usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.

notes.openai-agents: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.23.1: at 2026-07-28 the request arrives embedded in an `InputRequiredResult`. The adapter has no roots hook and calls tools through the MCP SDK's default `call_tool`, so the SDK's `Server returned InputRequiredResult` error reaches the caller as an `AgentsException` and nothing is answered.
notes.mastra: Mastra 2.2.0: its `inputRequests` hook answers elicitations only. An embedded `roots/list` fails with `no handler is registered for 'roots/list'`, as the docs say for the deprecated capability.
notes.strands: Strands Agents 1.59.0: `MCPClient` passes its `ClientSession` an `elicitation_callback` only. There is no roots parameter, so the client declares no roots capability and the server's `roots/list` is refused.
notes.vercel_ai: Vercel AI SDK (@ai-sdk/mcp 2.0.73): at 2026-07-28 the request arrives embedded in an `InputRequiredResult`. The client rejects any result with `resultType: "input_required"` ("multi round-trip requests are not supported yet"), so `execute` throws and nothing is answered. The client has no roots option either.
notes.openai_agents_js: OpenAI Agents SDK (JS) 0.20.0 at 2026-07-28: the server answers with `input_required`, and the MCP client the SDK builds tries to fulfil it itself, but no `roots/list` handler is registered on it and the SDK offers no option to add one. The call fails with `Cannot fulfil input request`, which the agent hands the model as tool-error text.
notes.agno: Agno 3.1.2: `MCPTools` builds its fastmcp `Client` with no roots and exposes no hook to set them, so `roots/list` is refused.
notes.dspy: DSPy 3.4.0: DSPy takes no roots handler. The server's request is answered only by a `list_roots_callback` registered on the caller's own `mcp.Client`, which DSPy is handed by `Tool.from_mcp_tool` and never configures. DSPy itself offers no route.
notes.langchain_js: LangChain.js (@langchain/mcp-adapters 2.0.1): the adapter declares no roots and offers no option for them. A legacy `roots/list` gets Method not found; a modern tool call that asks for roots fails with "asked for input this adapter cannot answer".
notes.copilot_sdk: GitHub Copilot SDK 1.0.19 (Copilot runtime 1.0.95): there is no session option to declare roots, and an embedded `roots/list` input request fails the call with "tools/call requested unsupported input method: roots/list".
notes.langchain4j: LangChain4j 1.22.0-beta32: `DefaultMcpClient.Builder.roots(List<McpRoot>)` registers roots, and the client answers `roots/list` at 2025-11-25. At 2026-07-28 the request arrives embedded in an `InputRequiredResult`, and the client throws `Server sent inputRequests that the client cannot handle` before the hook runs, so the measurement cannot tell whether the roots would have been sent.
notes.google_adk_go: Google ADK (Go) 2.5.0 (go-sdk 1.8.0): the embedded `roots/list` input request fails the call with `calling "tools/call": unexpected end of JSON input`. go-sdk's `InputRequestMap.UnmarshalJSON` (mcp/protocol.go) runs `json.Unmarshal` on the request's `params`, which is omitted for `roots/list`, so the `input_required` result is never decoded. A root added with `mcp.Client.AddRoots` cannot reach the server.

summary: Deprecated in 2026-07-28. The cell asks whether the adapter answers it through its own API.
